description: "Aristotle and Ancient Educational Ideals" by Thomas Davidson is a scholarly examination of the educational theories of Aristotle, framed within the historical context of ancient Greek education. Written in the late 19th century, this work delves into the principles and practices that characterized various Greek educational systems leading up to and following Aristotle's contributions.
